document_evidence.evidence_summary: Neither party may assign without prior written consent; Change of Control of Supplier constitutes an assignment; Supplier must notify Customer at least 30 days prior to completion.
If Change of Control completes without Customer's prior written consent, Customer may terminate on 90 days' written notice within 180 days after awareness.
Where Customer consents to a Change of Control, Customer may require re-negotiation of the Annual Subscription Fee in good faith.
Failure to meet 99.5% availability in three consecutive months entitles Customer to a service credit of up to 8% of the Annual Subscription Fee.
Initial Term of 36 months from 1 January 2023, expiring 31 December 2026.
Agreement renews automatically for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives at least 60 days' written notice of non-renewal.
Supplier warrants the effective discount of 18% is and shall remain not less favourable than discounts granted to any other customer of comparable annual committed spend.

If a more favourable effective discount is granted to a comparable customer, Supplier must notify Vantage within 30 days and apply the discount retrospectively with a credit note; comparable spend defined at 50% threshold.
Availability target of 99.5% monthly; if availability falls below 99.0% in any two consecutive months, Customer may terminate for material breach on 30 days' notice.
More than four Severity 1 incidents in any rolling three-month period triggers executive escalation and preserves remedies under Section 12.2.
Agreement may be assigned by either party to a successor in interest without consent if the assignee assumes all obligations in writing.
Thirty-six months from 1 April 2025.
Automatic renewal for successive twelve-month periods; sixty days' notice of non-renewal.
Supplier grants a discount of 34% against list pricing for the duration of the Initial Term in consideration of committed volume and reference account status.
Fees increase annually by the lesser of CPI-U change over the preceding 12 months and 3%.
Agreement is assignable to a successor in interest without consent.
Six-year term from 1 January 2024, expiring 31 December 2029.
Supplier appoints Reseller as its sole and exclusive distributor of the Harborline Platform in the Territory.
Territory means EU member states, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Norway.

Supplier shall not directly or indirectly market, license, sell, or deliver the Platform to customers in the Territory and must refer inbound Territory enquiries to Reseller within five Business Days.
Failure to meet the minimum in any two consecutive years entitles Supplier to convert the appointment to non-exclusive on twelve months' notice.
Supplier may terminate for convenience on twenty-four months' written notice, subject to payment of a termination sum equal to two times the trailing twelve month gross margin earned by Reseller.
Agreement is assignable to a successor in interest on notice; exclusivity survives any assignment and binds any successor in interest.
Customer previously had a 1 March 2021 MSA through operating subsidiary Cascade Foods; Prior Agreement expired on 28 February 2025 and was not renewed at that time.

Discount of 21% against list, increased from 15% under the Prior Agreement, reflecting interruption in service and re-tendering.

sql_evidence.methodology: Verified structured contract-to-customer mappings, contract dates, status, governing law, notice period, auto-renew flag, discount percentage, and source document references for contracts identified from documents and upstream catalog.
